rules: Weekly offbeat-signal hunt: one new idea a week, tested with study rules v2 (per-stock, baseline = better of always-up/always-down vs SPY over the same months, independent events, 20+ events, pass = hit rate above baseline and 95% Wilson lower bound above it too). Fails are logged here. A pass is not added to the site until Nick approves.
